title: Chapter 6275: War?

Chapter 6275: War?

Chapter 6275: War?

“Buzz.” Meanwhile, the entirety of Old World felt a particular pressure.

Cultivators, especially emperors and primal ancestors, became alarmed.

“Who is it?” Primal ancestors felt a suffocating pressure.

Remember, they were the top dogs in Old World so this feeling was foreign to them.

“What is going on?” Inhabitants knew something major was happening after sensing this pressure.

The scenery became distant as if it was being shifted somewhere else. Old World became just another piece in a greater world.

They saw a realm boundless beyond words, clearly superior to the land beneath.

“Desolate Frontier!” Everyone became emotional.

“What is it trying to do?” This question popped up in everyone’s mind.

“Is it leaving, or is it time for war?” An emperor wondered.

No one thought this was a positive development, especially Desolate Frontier’s enemies.

“Prepare.” Primal ancestors from the behemoths ordered.

Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect, Immortal Gate, and Trinity Kingdom have reigned Old World for so long. Alas, they became nervous upon seeing Desolate Frontier.

This tense atmosphere started at the top and spread across the realms.

“Another great war?” A desolate god shuddered.

“The first since Nightwatch.” One emperor worried because no one would be lucky enough to stay neutral.

Desolate Frontier and the behemoths wouldn’t be the first to go down, only the weakest sects first.

“I’m sure Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect is tense right now.” An emperor said.

“Desolate Frontier is just too strong now.” Another said.

When it came to numbers alone, Desolate Frontier didn’t have as many emperors and desolate gods compared to the behemoths.

They had five primal ancestors and twelve emperors. The emperors ranged in terms of power, not all at the apex level like the official ones from the other side.

However, their primal ancestors could crush anything. The list included Everlasting Jiang, Tenth-gen Chen, North Kun God, Whale Ancestor, and Absolute Ancestor.

If all five were to show up, the behemoths could not stop them.

“Boom!” A suffocating aura changed the shade of the sky. A terrible maelstrom emerged with thick lightning bolts and flames within them.

“A heavenly tribulation?!” This caused everyone to bellow in fear as they looked up at the maelstrom.

Emperors and primal ancestors became afraid, not wanting this tribulation to incite a personal one for them as well.

“Boom!” A majestic beam suddenly pierced through the maelstrom, pushing back the lightning bolts and flames.

A domineering aura intimidated all of Old World as they saw someone floating above - an old man wearing a simple robe devoid of unnecessary trinkets.

He had a tall and muscular frame, giving the impression of an unclimbable mountain. He encompassed the whole world, leaving no room for trespassers to get through.

His beard hanging down to his chest looked stalwart and heroic, accentuating his imposing gaze.

“Everlasting Jiang!” Spectators became alarmed.

“An older being than Desolate Ancestor.” Someone commented.

He was the oldest member of Desolate Frontier. Desolate Ancestor once addressed him as “Ancestor”.

He walked on a different path than everyone - the everlasting path. Only two other cultivators in Old World chose this path - Fardao and Tenacious.

“Is he the strongest being in Old World?” Another whispered.

“What about Fardao from God Frontier?” A big shot said.

“No, the strongest right now in Old World should be Dugu Yuan, very close to becoming a supreme overlord.” An emperor said.

“I would place him, Fardao, and Everlasting Jiang among the top three.” A primal ancestor said.
